transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 562 Loch Katrine Lane?
Yes, this is 562 Loch Katrine Lane. We’re trapped inside with four people, water’s in the house, and no help can come—no truck, no boat, no seats.
Acknowledged, we’ve noted your situation. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Four people total. Everyone can hear me.

I heard you, everyone can hear you. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave alone. No wheelchairs or oxygen here.
Understood, no one is unable to leave alone. Is there water inside the home right now?
Yes, water’s inside. We’re stuck, no help coming.
I hear you’re stuck and water’s inside. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats. We’re all stuck inside.
I hear you’re all stuck inside right now. Let me read that back: 4 people; water is inside. Is that right?
Yes, four people stuck inside. Water’s in the house.

Got it, four people stuck, water in the house. I've recorded that you need help leaving. No responder has been assigned yet. If water is rising inside, move to the highest floor and call 911 if you can get through. Goodbye.

house_card: Four people trapped inside, can't leave alone due to water inside. English language. Rescue needed immediately.
